item.title: Brilliant Trophy Chess tourney on March 14–15
item.description: Hyderabad: Brilliant Chess Academy will organise the 238th Brilliant Trophy Chess Tournament on March 14 and 15 at Brilliant Grammar High School in Dilsukhnagar.The event will offer a total prize pool of Rs 10,000 for the top 20 players in the Open category. Special prizes will also be awarded to the top two players in Under-7, 9, 11, 13 and 15 categories for boys and girls separately. Players must register before 1 pm on March 14 at the venue. For details, contact J. Subrahmanyam.

item.title: Aiyar, Tharoor face-off in ‘open letter war’
item.description: In an ‘open letter war’, Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar declared that he was parting ways with party colleague Shashi Tharoor while the latter hit back at the veteran politician for his “many gratuitous” comments. item.title: Explosions Rattle Dubai Buildings After Drone Interception Amid Ongoing Middle East War
item.description: Explosions shook buildings in central Dubai after the UAE intercepted a drone or missile amid the ongoing Middle East conflict.Debris damaged a building in DIFC, but no casualties were reported.

item.title: Lok Sabha adjourned till 2 PM over Oppn sloganeering; Rijiju admonishes conduct
item.description: The Lok Sabha witnessed repeated disruptions on Friday over sloganeering by the Opposition members leading to the adjournment of the House twice – first till 12 noon and then till 2 PM. The Opposition members sought debate on the shortages and short supply of LPG and kept raising slogans, despite the Chair turning down the request for the same.
